C0882.title: Supreme People's Court Typical Case: Organized Account-Unblocking Technical Support Sentenced
C0882.summary: In July 2025, the Supreme People Court released typical cases on punishing crimes of assisting information network criminal activities and related offenses. The case showed that Zhang and others opened a studio and, while knowing clients were using information networks to commit crimes, still provided technical support such as account unblocking. The court held relevant personnel criminally liable for assisting information network criminal activities, emphasizing that technical support for upstream fraud chains is also punishable. The case shows that seemingly peripheral services such as account unblocking, registration assistance, and top-ups become important links and profit support points in cybercrime chains when knowingly used for crime.

references.title: Typical Cases on Punishing Crimes Related to Assistance for Information Network Crimes
